# Pager

Helpers for splitting a result list into pages for the admin UI.

- `paginate(items, size)` returns a list of pages, each with at most `size` items.
  It never returns an empty page.
- `page_label(index, total)` returns the text shown above a page. `index` is the
  position in the list returned by `paginate`, starting at 0.

turns: paginate returns an extra empty page at the end when the number of items is an exact multiple of the page size, for example paginate([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) gives [[1, 2], [3, 4], []]. Fix it. TDD: targeted, test first for the exact-multiple case. No commits.
Looks good. One more in the same file: page_label(0, 3) says "Page 0 of 3" for the first page. It should say "Page 1 of 3". Fix that too, same rules as before.

# Shared lists

Users create lists and share them with other users. A list has one owner.
People a list is shared with can read it and add items.
